title: The specified Koszul-to-Cech chain comparison is an isomorphism
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number, f : Fin r → A, and F an integer-indexed complex of sheaves of modules on Spec(A), all of whose terms are quasi-coherent. The chain map koszulCechComparison A r f F [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction], from the specified Koszul Hom colimit to the principal alternating Cech total, is an isomorphism of A-module complexes.

source.place: Tag 08D1, canonical isomorphism of complexes and its sign calculation

proof.text: Identify F termwise with the associated sheaf of its global-section complex. Apply the localization identification of lem-sc-affine-koszul-hom-alternating-cech to the specified power transition system: on the ordered wedge indexed by J its coordinate is m/(product f_j)^(e+1). The defining cocone formula is this fraction multiplied by (-1)^(pq+p(p-1)/2). The sign matches the Hom and Cech total differentials. Finitely many rows and subsets allow the identification degreewise; invert its components to get the inverse chain map. For r=0 both complexes are zero, and r=1 is the single localization colimit.
